# BAD-010 — DMCA agent, takedown path and copyright page for hosted scenes and collab rooms

## Brief
From BadTakes TODO.md items 33 and 12. Bad Takes already hosts movie and TV media on behalf of users: collab rooms upload scene zips to the private collab bucket (live for every account on 0.11.0+ since 2026-08-25), the web app's hosted catalog serves scenes from scenes.badtakes.io, and public scene pages are designed (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-09-public-scene-pages-design.md). TODO 33 named a registered DMCA agent and a takedown path as the prerequisite for turning collab on; Eric shipped collab without them and accepted the exposure. This ticket builds the missing half. It also unblocks the user-upload scene library, [[BAD-019]] (TODO 12).

As of 2026-09-14: site/ has privacy.html but no DMCA, copyright or terms page; the collab function already has a 'report' mode; scripts/showcase.mjs can unpublish a catalog entry; the collab expiry sweep exists.

Scope:
- Eric's actions: designate a DMCA agent with the US Copyright Office (online registration, small fee, renew every three years) and choose the notice address.
- A copyright and takedown page on badtakes.io: how to send a notice and a counter-notice, the agent's details, and a repeat-infringer policy. Decide whether terms of service ship with it.
- An operator path in admin/ that turns a notice into action: close a collab room and delete its objects, unpublish a catalog scene, suspend an account, and log what was done and when.
- Link the page from the app (Settings, next to the privacy link BAD-002 added) and from the site footer.

Blocked on Eric for the agent registration and the policy wording. Needs a legal read, not just engineering. Never link the private GitHub repo from these pages; use badtakes.io.
